assignments.title: Explain how Generative AI differs from traditional rule-based and supervised ML systems using a real-world example.
assignments.description: Create a one-page concept map that contrasts traditional ML with Generative AI and Large Language Models. Use a concrete example (e.g., FAQ chatbot vs LLM assistant) to highlight differences in data requirements, capabilities, and limitations.

assignments.title: Describe the role of tokenization and embeddings in LLMs in your own words with a simple analogy.
assignments.description: Write a 500-word reflection explaining tokenization and embeddings, using an analogy from daily life (e.g., words as ingredients, embeddings as flavor profiles). Include how these concepts impact retrieval and generation quality.

assignments.title: Design prompts that transform a generic model into three different specialized assistants (e.g., teacher, recruiter, customer support agent).
assignments.description: Create at least 6 prompts (2 per role) showcasing zero-shot, few-shot, and chain-of-thought patterns. For each, show the system prompt, user prompt, and at least one sample response with brief commentary on why the prompt works.

assignments.title: Build a small CLI tool that queries an LLM API to summarize a given paragraph into bullet points.
assignments.description: Implement a Python script that takes text input, calls an LLM API (OpenAI/Gemini or local via Ollama), and prints a concise bullet-point summary. Include configuration via environment variables for API keys and parameters.

assignments.title: Evaluate how temperature and top-p influence the determinism and creativity of LLM outputs for the same task.
assignments.description: Choose a fixed task (e.g., explanation of binary search) and systematically vary temperature/top-p. Collect outputs in a table and write a 700-word analysis of how style, coherence, and variability change.

assignments.title: Design an end-to-end RAG pipeline for a “Department Handbook Assistant” for your college.
assignments.description: Draw and explain an architecture showing data ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector store, retrieval, reranking, and answer generation. Specify tools (e.g., LangChain/LlamaIndex, ChromaDB/FAISS) and justify design choices.

assignments.title: Implement a basic RAG-based PDF Question Answering system using LangChain or LlamaIndex.
assignments.description: Build a Python app that ingests at least one multi-page PDF, chunks it, stores embeddings in a vector DB, and answers user questions via a simple CLI or web UI. Include basic logging of queries and answers.

assignments.title: Measure and compare the quality of answers from a RAG system vs a pure LLM (no retrieval) on a fixed test set.
assignments.description: Prepare at least 15 domain-specific questions, run them on both “LLM-only” and your RAG system, and manually rate answers for correctness and faithfulness. Summarize results in charts and a short report.

assignments.title: Design robust tool/function calling schemas for three tools: web_search, calculator, and calendar_lookup.
assignments.description: Specify JSON schemas (parameters, types, descriptions, constraints) for each tool so that an LLM can call them reliably. Include 3 example prompts and expected tool call JSON for each.

assignments.title: Build an AI agent that can answer questions using both web search (or mock search) and a local knowledge base via RAG.
assignments.description: Using LangChain/LangGraph or similar, implement an agent with at least two tools: a search-like tool (real or stubbed) and a RAG tool over a small document set. Demonstrate multi-step reasoning for 5 queries.

assignments.title: Design a multi-agent workflow for “AI Research Assistant” with at least three roles.
assignments.description: Define roles (e.g., Researcher, Summarizer, Critic), responsibilities, communication protocol, and failure-handling strategy. Represent the workflow as a sequence diagram with narrative explanation.

assignments.title: Prepare a deployment and monitoring plan for turning a classroom prototype agent/RAG app into a production-ready service.
assignments.description: Describe target environment (server/on-prem/cloud), API gateway, authentication, logging, metrics, alerting, and versioning strategy for prompts and models. Include a simple CI/CD outline using GitHub.

assignments.title: Containerize a simple LLM-powered API using FastAPI and Docker.
assignments.description: Expose a /generate endpoint that calls an LLM (hosted or local), package the app in a Docker image, and provide steps to run it locally. Include basic request validation and error responses.

assignments.title: Analyze an LLM misuse scenario (e.g., harmful content, data leakage) and propose concrete guardrails and policies.
assignments.description: Given a short case describing potential misuse in an educational or enterprise setting, write a 1500-word analysis covering risks, stakeholders, mitigation strategies (prompting, filters, access control), and monitoring.

assignments.title: Write a policy brief for your department on how to responsibly adopt agentic AI and RAG systems over the next 3 years.
assignments.description: Summarize key trends (on-device LLMs, RAG+agents, MCP ecosystem), opportunities, risks, and recommended guidelines for student/faculty use in 2–3 pages targeted at HOD/principal.

assignments.title: Prepare a comprehensive Software Test Plan and Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM) for an Online Shopping System.

assignments.title: Analyze the performance of a web application using Apache JMeter.

assignments.title: Conduct Risk-Based Testing and perform a basic OWASP security assessment for an e-commerce application.

assignments.title: Design and implement a complete End-to-End Software Testing Solution integrating Manual Testing, Automation, API Testing, Performance Testing, CI/CD, and Defect Management.
assignments.description: Students will execute a real-world testing project by preparing test artefacts, automating functional tests, testing APIs, performing load testing, managing defects using Jira, integrating automated execution with Jenkins, creating testing dashboards, and presenting project outcomes.
